tour.dashboard.welcomeBody: This tour shows the sidebar links and the main dashboard. On small screens the sidebar is hidden—use the bottom tabs instead.
tour.dashboard.sidebarBody: Use this column to move between your dashboard, predictions, wallet, power-ups, global pot, and your groups.
tour.dashboard.navDashboardBody: Your home overview: stats, upcoming matches, and your leagues.
tour.dashboard.navPredictionsBody: Make and manage score predictions for upcoming fixtures.
tour.dashboard.navWalletBody: Buy coins with secure checkout. Coins pay for power-ups.
tour.dashboard.navPowerupsBody: Activate shield, freeze, or multiplier effects for your group (UTC day rules).
tour.dashboard.navGlobalPotBody: World Cup global leaderboard across groups.
tour.dashboard.groupsNavBody: Jump into a private league, or create/join one from here.
tour.dashboard.statsBody: A quick snapshot of your prediction performance.
tour.dashboard.upcomingBody: Fixtures you can make a prediction on—deadlines depend on kickoff time.
tour.dashboard.recentBody: Your latest picks and results in one place.
tour.dashboard.leaguesBody: Cards for each group you belong to—open one to see standings, group predictions, and rivalries.
tour.dashboard.mobileNavBody: On mobile, use this bar to move quickly between core sections.
tour.dashboard.mobileGroupsBody: Open your private leagues and group actions.
tour.dashboard.mobilePredictBody: Go straight to upcoming fixtures and your predictions.
tour.dashboard.mobileWalletBody: Buy coins, then use coins to buy power-up inventory.
tour.wallet.introBody: Coins are used for power-ups. Purchases go through Stripe checkout.
tour.wallet.balanceBody: Your current coin balance updates after successful purchases.
tour.wallet.bundlesBody: Pick a bundle and tap Buy to open checkout in your browser.
tour.powerups.introBody: Use this page to buy power-up inventory with coins, then activate what you own.
tour.powerups.inventoryBody: See how many shields, freezes, and multipliers you currently own.
tour.powerups.buyBody: Choose quantity and buy a power-up type using your coin balance.
tour.powerups.catalogBody: Shield protects your day, Freeze targets another user, and Multiplier boosts one of your predicted upcoming matches.
tour.powerups.activateBody: Pick a power-up you own, choose required fields, and activate it for the selected UTC day.
tour.powerups.howToUseBody: Select source group first, then pick power-up: Shield needs a match date, Freeze needs target user plus that user's match date, and Multiplier needs one upcoming predicted match tile.
tour.powerups.rulesBody: Activations consume inventory. Freeze costs 2 inventory when targeting outside your source group. Multiplier is limited to one active effect per user per UTC day in a group.
tour.globalPot.introBody: Compare your World Cup scoring against everyone on the platform.
tour.globalPot.headerBody: Pick the season and see whether the canonical leaderboard is locked.
tour.globalPot.tableBody: Rankings, points, rivalry wins, and which group each score comes from.
tour.predictions.introBody: Work through upcoming fixtures and manage your picks.
tour.predictions.listBody: This list ties to your groups fixtures—submit or edit before kickoff where allowed.
tour.groupHome.introBody: Everything here is scoped to this one league.
tour.groupHome.headerBody: Name, league, invite code, and member count.
tour.groupHome.actionsBody: Open group predictions, rivalries, or manage if you are admin.
tour.groupHome.tabsBody: Switch between the table and the member list.
tour.groupPredictions.controlsBody: Change the match week and toggle grid or list view.
tour.groupPredictions.mainBody: Submit or edit scores for this week before the deadline.
tour.rivalries.introBody: Head-to-head weeks with bonus points when it is rivalry week.
tour.rivalries.headerBody: See whether this week is a rivalry week and review active matchups.
tour.rivalries.tabsBody: Switch between ongoing rivalries and past results.
tour.createGroup.introBody: This wizard runs in three steps: give your league a name, pick which real-world competition it follows (season is chosen for you), then select teams to track. After you create the league, you will land on the group page with an invite code to share.
tour.createGroup.pageHeaderBody: The title reminds you where you are. Use Back to leagues to leave without saving. The small help icon opens the original step-by-step guide if you prefer it.
tour.createGroup.progressBody: The highlighted label shows which step you are on. You must complete them in order: name, then competition, then tracked teams.
tour.createGroup.activeStepBody: Fill in what is shown here. Use Next on step 1, tap a league card on step 2 (that advances automatically), then pick teams and press Create league on step 3. Back returns to the previous step without losing what you already entered.
tour.createGroup.worldCupTitle: World Cup and the global pot
tour.createGroup.worldCupBody: You can follow club leagues or the World Cup. If you pick World Cup, this group must track every national team in the draw together. That lines up with the global World Cup leaderboard and how canonical entries lock after the configured date or once group-stage matchday 2 is fully finished.
tour.createGroup.leagueGridWorldCupBody: Tap a card for the league or World Cup you want. World Cup uses the 2026 season automatically.
tour.createGroup.teamsWorldCupBody: For World Cup, every national side stays selected; the form does not let you drop teams. Other competitions let you toggle which clubs you track.

groupPredictions.guideWelcomeContent: This page shows all predictions made by your group members for the selected week. You can see how everyone predicted each match and compare results.
groupPredictions.guideWeekContent: Use the week selector to view predictions for different weeks. The current week is marked with '(Current)'. Different leagues have different numbers of weeks.
groupPredictions.guideViewContent: Switch between Grid view (shows match cards) and List view (compact format). Grid view is great for seeing match details, while List view is perfect for quick scanning.
groupPredictions.guideResultsContent: Each prediction shows the user's predicted score and points earned. Perfect predictions (exact score) earn 3 points, correct results earn 1 point. Points are only shown for processed predictions.
